abstract: While sacrococcygeal teratoma presents typically at birth as a mass lesion, we had a case of late presentation with the classical triad of urinary retention, constipation and weakness of legs. Interesting enough, a tuft of hair together with a small lump was noted at birth and an associated small meningocoele was found at operation. We review the literature with regard to pathogenesis, clinical features, differential diagnosis, malignant change and treatment of the tumour.
abstract_ja: 晩期に発症した仙尾部奇形腫の稀な症例を報告する。症状は排尿障害、便秘、下肢の脱力という典型的な三徴であった。出生時には一房の毛髪と小さな腫瘤が認められており、手術時には小さな髄膜瘤が認められた。本症例を含め、病因、臨床像、鑑別診断、悪性転化、治療について文献的に考察する。
